layman_headline: Market is hot after a huge rally week — patience beats FOMO right now.
layman_explanation: Crypto just had an explosive week with BTC up 23%, ETH up 28%, and XRP up 43%. Everything is extended and starting to pull back. Our XRP position entered near the top and is now down 8.3%, but hasn't hit our stop-loss yet. The smart move is to wait for this pullback to settle before adding new positions — chasing pumps is how traders get burned.
layman_action: Hold the current XRP position and monitor the stop-loss at $1.30. Don't add new positions until this pullback finds support. Watch ETH around $2,350 as a potential entry if it pulls back further.
expert_reasoning: The entire market just experienced a massive rally week (BTC +22.8%, ETH +28.5%, XRP +42.8%, ZEC +56%) and is now consolidating with 24h pullbacks across the board. Fear & Greed at 65 and declining from 74 yesterday suggests momentum is cooling. CoinDesk warns the greed gauge is at levels last seen before October's $19B wipeout. The $6.4B BTC options expiry on Friday will likely amplify volatility and could provide better entry points. All swing candidates are either stablecoins (no trade), overbought (PUMP RSI 86), or heavily extended (LIT +46%, XRP +43%). No clean entry exists right now. ETH is the best watchlist candidate given derivatives are resetting and it has strong fundamental backing from $49B Ethereum TVL.
risk_factors: Friday's $6.4B BTC options expiry could trigger a sharp market-wide correction
Fear & Greed at levels that preceded the October $19B wipeout — correction risk elevated
BTC dominance at 59.3% continues to suppress altcoin performance relative to BTC
watch_list: Friday $6.4B BTC options expiry — watch for volatility spike and potential flush to set up entries
XRP price action relative to $1.30 stop-loss — if it breaks, exit immediately
ETH price around $2,350-$2,400 zone — if it pulls back to this level with stabilizing RSI, it becomes a strong BUY candidate
market_context: Markets are in a post-rally cooldown after one of the strongest weeks of 2026. BTC holding $79K but most alts pulling back 3-7% on the day, with a massive options expiry Friday likely to determine if this rally has legs or needs a deeper reset.
context_banner: After a blistering rally week, the market needs to digest gains before offering clean swing entries — the Friday options expiry is the next major inflection point.

key_signals.description: $6.4B BTC options expiry Friday will amplify volatility — better entries likely emerge after this event resolves.
Crypto greed gauge at highest since just before October's $19B wipeout — a warning signal for overextended positioning.
Fear & Greed index at 65 (Greed) declining from 74 yesterday — momentum fading after the rally, supporting a wait-and-see approach.
CryptoQuant says BTC entering 'initial phase' of new bull market but $83K is key resistance — structurally bullish but short-term caution warranted.
PUMP's RSI at 86 confirms overbought conditions across recent movers — no swing candidates offer clean technical entries right now.
